evals.prompt: I fixed a typo in the getting-started guide. Open a PR for it.
evals.expected_output: Branch created off the default branch (docs/-style name suggested and confirmed), change committed with the repository's subject convention and sign-off practice discovered from history, body built from the repo's PR template via --body-file with no unfilled placeholder, render verified, PR URL and verify commands reported.

evals.prompt: Open a PR for the current change. The repository has a .tailrocks/pr.md.
evals.expected_output: Conventions file honored over defaults: ticket-id branch scheme applied (ticket id requested if missing), DCO sign-off and Ticket: trailer on the commit, body carries the three required sections with real verify commands.

evals.prompt: Just commit this straight to main and open the PR from main — it's a one-line change, branching is overkill.
evals.expected_output: Refuse to commit to the base branch regardless of change size; create a prefixed branch instead and proceed with the normal flow.
